digest.component_or_area: config sources and resolvers module split
propositions: src/rebar/_config_sources.py is 791 LOC, exceeds near-cap warning band (>=720) and is nine lines under the 800-LOC limit, blocking future config changes
The file contains two distinct concerns: raw-input resolution (lines 31-361) and RP-04 below-seam owned resolvers (lines 364-791), separated by in-file banners
Moving the 29 resolver symbols and helpers to a new _config_resolvers.py creates one-directional dependency: only _snapshot_table reaches back into raw-input layer for three functions
All 29 moved names must be re-exported from _config_sources.py to preserve byte-identical import surface and prevent breaking changes to rebar._config_sources and rebar.config
Late binding of reached-back names in _snapshot_table through lazy in-body module import must be verified to survive monkeypatching and maintain acyclic import structure
Composition root classification and env-var registry must be updated to recognize _config_resolvers.py as a config ownership seam alongside _config_sources.py
